title: Title & Registration Services Fee-Shortage Returns: the Buyer's Cure Payment and Its Payment Tool
content:
## When it applies

A Title & Registration Services packet that the state sends back as short is a fee-shortage return. Within the service type's fee shortage collection days after a fee-shortage return, the buyer pays, as its own entry, either the buyer's cure share of the stated shortage when the return states an amount or the late-registration penalty when the return states no amount; the rest of a stated shortage is Kestrel's own cost.

A fee-shortage return that states no amount is not a stated shortage under this rule; the buyer's cure payment arises only from a return that states an amount.

## The buyer's payment tool: `pay_title_fee_shortage_f6fcb150`

**What it does.** The buyer pays, in person, a payment toward the fee shortage the state named when it sent the title and registration packet back. One run books one payment from the buyer on the title and registration order as a state fee collected against the registration fee, dated that day, and adds the amount to the state fees Kestrel is holding on that order for the state. The buyer sees the payment on the order's history immediately.

**Who runs it.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`. The agent does not run it on the customer's behalf.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `title_order_id` | the reference number of the buyer's title and registration order, as shown by the title and registration order lookup for this buyer before the call | identifier, copied as shown |
| `amount` | the payment the buyer makes now | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` reading `payment_recorded` when the payment was booked, `title_txn_id` (reference number of the new fee entry), `title_order_id` (the order paid on), `fee_type` (always `registration_fee`), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places as booked), `txn_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `state_fees_held` (USD with 2 decimal places now held on the order after this payment). No error responses are defined for this tool.

## Hypothetical receipt

A buyer paying 31.20 on a title and registration order that already held 0.00 receives a receipt showing `payment_recorded`, `fee_type` `registration_fee`, `amount` 31.20 and `state_fees_held` 31.20; the order's history shows the new fee entry dated the day of payment.
